notes: DEVIATIONS/DECISIONS (all recorded in docs/decisions.md UC-008 section): (1) aspnet:9.0 -> 10.0 corrected (project is net10.0) in api/Dockerfile comment + decisions.md. (2) api/Dockerfile also fixes two latent build problems the pre-existing stub had: it COPYs api/Directory.Build.props BEFORE dotnet restore (the EF-version MSB3277 pin was previously missed by the Docker context) and installs curl in the aspnet:10.0 runtime (base ships neither curl nor wget, so a HEALTHCHECK would always report unhealthy); uses USER $APP_UID (framework non-root user) + HEALTHCHECK /health/live. (3) IMAGE SIZE <120MB is aspirational on Debian aspnet base (~220MB); alpine base is the documented honest path (follow-up) — size marked operational-deferred. (4) EDGE Caddy REQUIRES a custom xcaddy build (infra/caddy/Dockerfile: caddy-dns/cloudflare + caddy-dns/hetzner + mholt/caddy-ratelimit) because stock caddy:2-alpine has neither DNS-01 TLS plugins nor rate_limit — this is why `caddy validate` is NOT claimed. The web container's INNER Caddyfile (infra/web/Caddyfile, static serve + /api+/hubs WS proxy) runs on stock caddy:2-alpine. (5) SCOPE-DEVIATION on web/Caddyfile: the designer listed web/Caddyfile in C1 files_touched, but my staging allow-list is /web/Dockerfile (not web/*). Resolved by putting the static Caddyfile at infra/web/Caddyfile and COPYing it in web/Dockerfile (build context = repo root) — nothing staged under web/ except Dockerfile + .dockerignore. (6) Wildcard DNS-01 TLS is primary (Cloudflare + Hetzner acme_dns variants documented); on-demand-TLS fallback documented as the trade-off. (7) Backups: rclone S3 (Hetzner Object Storage default, Backblaze B2 variant), postgres:16-alpine base so pg_dump major-version matches; restore.sh does NOT --exit-on-error and does NOT fail on pg_restore's rc — the SELECT count(*) FROM orders sanity check is authoritative (a cross-minor client emits benign SET transaction_timeout warnings). retain 14 daily + 8 weekly. (8) Migrations run out-of-band via `docker compose run --rm api migrate` (WI A1 subcommand) in deploy.yml BEFORE up -d; prod adds no startup-migrate (Production skips the Development-only startup MigrateAsync). (9) ops fleet is config-driven Ops:FleetSlug (default ops) for the 5xx pager (A3) + disk-alert SMS. (10) DEV compose: preserved the e2e-api.mjs harness contract EXACTLY (only `up -d db` is used by the harness; api/web services added for full-stack `up` do not claim 5432/5249 nor block db). (11) Optional Grafana+Prometheus behind compose --profile ops (not running by default); prometheus scrapes api:8080/metrics on the internal net only (Caddy does not proxy /metrics — enforces A2's internal-only AC). costs.md prices cited 2026-09-13: Hetzner CX22 EUR4.35/mo, Hetzner Object Storage EUR4.99/mo, .cz domain ~EUR0.60/mo, DNS/TLS/uptime free -> ~EUR9.94/mo fixed; SMS ~EUR18/mo variable (excluded from target); marginal per fleet = SMS only. DEPENDENCY on parallel A1 agent: the `migrate` and `send-sms` CLI subcommands in Program.cs are referenced by deploy.yml + monitoring.md/disk-alert but implemented by A1 (not touched here — api/src is the backend agent's scope). MINOR CALL-OUTS (advisor round 2): (a) deploy.yml uses secrets.VPS_USER in addition to the spec's stated 'only VPS_HOST/VPS_SSH_KEY/GHCR_TOKEN' — SSH needs a username; kept as a secret rather than hardcoding root. If strict 3-secret compliance is required, drop VPS_USER and set username: root. (b) deploy.yml rollback reverts the IMAGE to the previous SHA but does NOT un-apply the migration that ran this deploy — safe only for backward-compatible migrations; runbook step 7 now carries this caveat (destructive migration -> restore from backup, not image rollback). (c) The edge Caddyfile `rate_limit @auth { zone auth { key {remote_host} events 60 window 1m } }` directive shape must be confirmed against the mholt/caddy-ratelimit README when the xcaddy image is built — a wrong shape fails at edge startup, not at yaml-parse time (caddy validate is deferred to the xcaddy build).
